protocolsAtBoundaries.notes: Retains the boundary review at 76466a5 and its inherited exact-reference allocation, native custody, five-table presence, raid witness, and canonical parser findings. No serialized fields, wire format, receipt identity or quarantine-release authority changed. This structural review does not sign native callback behavior, save/load or ordinary play, and excludes Claude's unresolved spawn-custody work.
